facts.text: I am looking for gift ideas for a coworker's baby shower.
I want the gift to be eco-friendly and cute.
I gave my sister a silver necklace with a small pendant for her birthday last month.
My sister loved the silver necklace with a small pendant.
I like the organic cotton onesie and baby blanket set idea.
I want brands that offer customization options for baby onesies and blankets.
I asked about the price range for customized onesies and blankets.
I asked whether customized onesies and blankets offer gift wrapping or gift boxing options.
I am thinking of getting a customized onesie and blanket set from Hanna Andersson.
I asked whether Hanna Andersson has any sales or promotions going on right now.
I think I will place the order now.
I am glad I got a silver necklace with a small pendant for my sister's birthday last month.
I asked whether Hanna Andersson offers expedited shipping options.
I asked whether Hanna Andersson can gift wrap the onesie and blanket set in a box.
I asked whether Hanna Andersson will include a gift receipt with the gift-wrapped onesie and blanket set.
